units.source_text: 此后，我每天晚上都依靠柏木送给我的尺八练习本，勤学苦练起尺八来。

en.t: After that, every night I relied on the shakuhachi practice book Kashiwagi had given me and began studying the instrument with great diligence.

units.source_text: 随着能吹奏（白地染上了红太阳）等曲子，我和他的交往又恢复到过去的亲密程度了。

en.t: As I became able to play pieces such as White Cloth Dyed with a Red Sun, my relationship with him returned to its former intimacy.
